donor_states.note: Itemized donations from individuals (over $200), by the donor's state.

donor_employers.note: Itemized donations from individuals (over $200), grouped by the employer donors listed, as spelled in FEC records. Retired, self-employed and not-employed entries are left out.

sources.pac_contributions: FEC contributions from committees to candidates (pas2), direct and in-kind contributions; outside spending from independent expenditures in the same file
